n = 31

def s_var(v, i):
    offset = 0
    for vv in range(1, v):

    return offset + i

# Precompute s_var offsets

    off += (61 - v)

def s_var2(v, i):

# For each value v: exactly one starting position must be chosen

    lits = [s_var2(v, i) for i in valid_starts]
    
    # At least one
    solver.add_clause(lits)
    
    # At most one (pairwise)
    for a in range(len(lits)):
        for b in range(a+1, len(lits)):

    true_vars = set(x for x in model if x > 0)
